_scoring.method: blind list per law from the marked packet text, saved before opening data/duties, data/powers, data/dropped, data/effective_dates; class counts by python over all 9 sessions (33,300 records: duties + powers)

_classes.name: fixed_date deadline stored with null deadline_date
list items of a content lead-in ("shall include") stored as separate records
_classes.rule: re.match(r'^\(?([a-z]|[ivx]{1,4}|\d{1,2})[\.\)] ', quote) and no modal (shall|must|may|is authorized|empowered|directed|will) in quote; not caught by sub_item_of_parent, probably because the parent -05 had a junk agency

_classes.name: generic State board/agency actor left Unspecified
agency set to the passive subject phrase (Monies in the Fund, Website ...)
_classes.rule: normalized agency == normalized actor_raw and not agency_group and actor_raw starts with monies|moneys|fund|website|amount|payment|notice|such (agency_matched is True for these: the crosswalk accepts them as a named body)

_classes.name: act-clause early-implementation proviso stored as power
local body or population phrase in place of locality group/unit
_classes.rule: re.search(r'(?i)city of one million|population of', agency_unit) or re.search(r'(?i)^(nassau|suffolk|westchester|erie|monroe|orange|rockland) county .*(agency|bureau|department)', agency)

_classes.name: list item under a mandatory lead held as power (known, fixed Oct 17; recurrence)
_classes.rule: kind == 'power' and no modal at all in quote (may|authoriz|empower|power|discretion|permit|shall|must); upper bound, also matches legitimate items under a may lead

_classes.name: same sentence reprinted in parallel or successive sections stored twice
_classes.rule: no mechanical rule separates these from legitimate parallel provisions (identical quote+agency+kind gives 845 groups / 1,168 extra records; adding citation gives 273 / 414, which misses these because the citations differ)

_classes.name: reprinted or narrowed existing duty stored as a record
_classes.rule: needs_judgment: the new matter is a word swap or a narrowing proviso inside a pre-existing duty sentence

_classes.name: passive or entitlement subject with Unspecified actor (known class; recurrence)
_classes.rule: agency == 'Unspecified' and actor_raw has no government noun (commission|department|...|supervisor)

2011-A7602-01.quote: Absentee ballots received by the board of elections shall be retained at the board of elections and cast and canvassed pursuant to the provisions of section 9-209 of this chapter

2011-A7602-02.quote: each central board of inspectors shall examine, cast, and canvass the envelopes and the ballots therein contained as nearly as practicable in the following manner

2011-A7602-03.quote: or if there is no name on the envelope, or if the envelope is not sealed, Such envelope shall be laid aside unopened.

2011-A7602-04.quote: If there is more than one ballot envelope executed by the same voter, the one bearing the later date of execution shall be accepted and the other rejected.

2011-A7602-05.quote: If it cannot be determined which envelope bears the later date, then all Such envelopes shall be rejected.

2011-A7602-06.quote: If Such person is found to be registered and has not voted in person, an inspector shall compare the signature, if Any, on each envelope with the signature, if Any, on the registration poll record,

2011-A7602-07.quote: If the signatures are found to correspond, Such inspector shall certify thereto by signing his or her initials in the "inspector's initials" line on the computer generated list of registered voters or in the "remarks" column as appropriate.

2011-A7602-08.quote: If Such person is found to be registered and has not voted in person, and if no challenge is made, or if a challenge made is not sustained, the envelope shall be opened, the ballot or ballots withdrawn without unfolding, and the ballot or ballots deposited in the proper ballot box or boxes, or envelopes

2011-A7602-09.quote: If not, the ballot shall be rejected without inspection or unfolding and shall be returned to the envelope which shall be endorsed "not enrolled."

2011-A7602-10.quote: the inspectors shall enter the words "absentee vote" or "military vote" in the space reserved for the voter's signature on the aforesaid list or in the "remarks" column as appropriate, and shall enter the year and month of the Election on the same line in the spaces provided therefor.

2011-A7602-11.quote: As each envelope is opened, if one or more of the different kinds of ballots to be voted at the Election are not found therein, the clerks, or inspectors, shall make a memorandum showing what ballot or ballots are missing.

2011-A7602-12.quote: If a ballot envelope shall contain more than one ballot for the same offices, all the ballots in Such envelope shall be rejected.

2011-A7602-13.quote: the clerks or inspectors shall ascertain the number of Such ballots of each kind which have been deposited in the ballot box by deducting from the number of envelopes opened the number of missing ballots, and shall make a return thereof.

2011-A7602-14.quote: The number of absentee voters' ballots deposited in the ballot box shall be added to the number of other ballots deposited in the ballot box, in order to determine the number of all ballots of each kind to be accounted for in the ballot box.

2023-S7537-01.quote: There is hereby established within the department of state a village incorporation commission.

2023-S7537-05.quote: The commission shall: a. accept petitions filed pursuant to this article;

2023-S7537-06.quote: accept petitions filed pursuant to this article; b. hold hearings as required by this article;

2023-S7537-07.quote: accept and deposit with the state comptroller all such monies required to be paid by those seeking to incorporate a village pursuant to this article

2023-S7537-08.quote: d. evaluate petitions filed pursuant to this article and make decisions with regard to whether a village incorporation election shall proceed based upon the commission's judgment of the criteria established in sections 2-200 and 2-206 of this article and any other requirements established in this article.

2023-S7537-09.quote: the village incorporation commission established pursuant to section 2-259 of this article shall cause to be posted in five public places located in the territory where such village shall be incorporated and also to be published at least twice

2023-S7537-10.quote: The village incorporation commission established pursuant to section 2-259 of this article shall meet at the time and place specified in such notice and shall hear objections which may be presented as to the incorporation based upon any of the following grounds

2023-S7537-11.quote: 2. The commission shall conduct the hearing. 3. All objections must be in writing

2023-S7537-12.quote: the village incorporation commission established pursuant to section 2-259 of this article shall determine whether the petition complies with the requirements of this article and shall make and sign a decision as to whether a village incorporation shall proceed to election pursuant to the criteria established in section 2-259 of this article

2023-S7537-13.quote: shall be filed by the commission within fifteen days after the hearing is concluded, with the town clerk of the same town in which the original copy of the petition was filed.

2023-S7537-14.quote: the expenses incurred by the towns in which any part of such territory is located for payment of cost of posting, publishing and serving required notices, stenographic services and services of inspectors of election shall be paid from the fund deposited with the village incorporation commission established pursuant to section 2-259 of this article

2023-S7537-15.quote: The first study shall consist of a feasibility assessment, which shall examine the proposed village's ability to provide services to its population in an efficient manner. The feasibility study shall also evaluate the proposed village's fiscal capacity to provide these services

2023-S7537-16.quote: The second study shall consist of an impact assessment that shall evaluate the fiscal and operational effects of incorporation on the surrounding town and the rest of the local area. These impacts shall include fiscal, service, political, environmental, and land use impacts.

2023-S7537-18.quote: The report required pursuant to paragraph c of this subdivision shall be published on the public facing portion of the department of state's website

2023-S7537-20.quote: the commission shall post a notice of its decision on the public-facing portion of the department of state's website.

2023-S7537-24.quote: monies constituting the funds of the village incorporation commission established pursuant to section 2-259 of the village law shall be deposited with the state comptroller and held for the purposes of the village incorporation commission established in article two of the village law

2023-S7537-17.quote: the village incorporation commission shall also produce a report on its recommendations with regard to the village incorporation process pursuant to this article.
2023-S7537-17.note: report is due with the transmission "on or before two years from the effective date of this section" (para d), not on_effective_date

2023-S7537-19.quote: the secretary of state or his or her designee shall transmit the commission's findings and recommendations to the speaker of the assembly, the temporary president of the senate, and the governor on or before two years from the effective date of this section.
2023-S7537-19.note: actor is "the secretary of state or his or her designee", not the commission

2023-S7537-21.quote: No village incorporation election shall proceed in the event the commission rules adversely to such incorporation, except pursuant to the provisions of section 2-210 of this article.
2023-S7537-21.note: "No village incorporation election shall proceed in the event the commission rules adversely": the consequence of decision -08, with no actor

2023-S7537-22.quote: No village incorporation election shall proceed until January first, two thousand twenty-four.
2023-S7537-22.note: "No village incorporation election shall proceed until January first, two thousand twenty-four": a start cutoff, not an actor duty (criterion 5: a cutoff is not a deadline)

2023-S7537-23.quote: The decision of the village incorporation commission established pursuant to section 2-259 of this article as to whether a village incorporation shall proceed to election shall be subject to judicial review in the manner provided in article seventy-eight of the civil practice law and rules.
2023-S7537-23.note: "shall be subject to judicial review in the manner provided in article seventy-eight": reprinted review clause with the decider renamed; it grants courts no new power
